prompt: Cinematic film still, 35mm anamorphic wide establishing shot inside a data hall aisle. Split-screen diptych divided by a clean vertical seam: left half, a heavy graphite steel turnstile gate locked across a dark server rack row, its shadow deep; right half, a wall-mounted electro-mechanical meter with a needle swung into a red zone beside an active server rack glowing warm amber.
